qualification_checks.Q1_source_materializable: X and Y source objects must be retrievable as auditable data or exact published observation tables rather than only narrative conclusions
qualification_checks.Q2_common_key_materializable: X and Y must expose a joinable predeclared site/population and event-time key without inferring identity from broad geography
qualification_checks.Q3_event_estimand_materializable: X must directly encode the declared event-side state or outcome
qualification_checks.Q4_function_estimand_materializable: Y must directly encode the declared biological function or a prospectively justified sufficient observation of that function
qualification_checks.Q5_absence_adequacy_predeclared: a negative Y answer is allowed only where the observation design has prospectively sufficient temporal/spatial/detection coverage for the declared function
qualification_checks.Q6_provenance_separation_preserved: materialization must not reveal that R reuses the same observation stream as X or Y
qualification_checks.Q7_no_posthoc_key_or_function_redefiniti: event key and F definition cannot be changed after values are seen
